/**
 * Catalog
 * Built by FlowCode from the app model; it reads and writes the app's store and look-up layer (src/app/).
 */
import { LookupCatalog } from "../sections/LookupCatalog";
import { useHashId } from "../sections/AppData";
import { go } from "../app/routes";
import { lookup } from "../app/lookup";

export default function CatalogScreen() {
  const arg = useHashId("catalog");
  const query = arg?.startsWith("q=") ? arg.slice(2) : undefined;
  const category = arg && !query ? arg : undefined;
  return (
    <LookupCatalog
      key={arg ?? "all"}
      lookup={lookup}
      title={"Catalog"}
      category={category}
      query={query}
      onOpen={(id) => go("product", id)}
      onCategory={(c) => go("catalog", c)}
      onSearch={(s) => go("catalog", `q=${s}`)}
    />
  );
}
